description: Dependency updates (REPO_STANDARDS §10, D152): a 7-day minimum release age, SHA-pinned actions, grouped updates, Conventional Commits with a DCO sign-off. Pull requests open as drafts, which CI doesn't run: mark one ready for review (gh pr ready) to check it. They rebase only on conflicts, since the merge queue tests each against main's head.

packageRules.description: Minor and patch npm updates travel together, one pull request a week.
Majors get their own pull request and the version-churn guidance check (D48).
prBodyNotes: A major update: update the "write this, not that" churn guidance and lint rules in the same pull request if the API changed (D48).

packageRules.description: TypeScript 6 stays pinned for the tools that need the compiler API (REPO_STANDARDS §4).
The pnpm the runtime bundle ships for installs stays on 10 (D94: pnpm 11 and later carry pnpr/ code); the repository's own pnpm (packageManager) is unaffected.
Node stays on the LTS line D48 names; the move to 26 is a deliberate change.
